component.name: Mac Sensors
component.summary: Temperatures and fans of Intel Macs and other machines

description.p: Mac Sensors shows the temperatures and fans of an Intel Mac on a drawing of the machine: CPU, graphics, memory, chipset, display and power supply, with a live history per sensor and the fan speed.

On illumos it reads the Apple System Management Controller through the applesmc driver and smcstat, and the CPU and chipset sensors of any machine through the kernel sensor framework (/dev/sensors). Profiles exist for the Mac Pro (Late 2013) and the iMacs of 2011 to 2013; other machines get the cards without a drawing.
iMac (21.5-inch, Late 2013) profile: graphics in the CPU, mainboard card when there is no drive sensor; model names in the header.
